design.decision: Re-read the hand after Opening and bid for the new [A]s, which may sit in a short suit worth leading early.
design.opponent: Revealed at Opening; opponents see extra [A]s fall and should not count on their [K]s.
design.rationale: Unlike becoming [K]s (seed-become-king, -1.2), an [A] destination never downgrades a card, so it is an honest upgrade worth buying with no payoff; two cards keeps it common-sized.
design.draftText: Opening: Two cards your team holds become [A]s

history.note: draft-common: merged into cb-become-ace, an identical design from another cluster.
